npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.dating_acc: You... what? Didn't see that coming. Well, I'll be damned. You've certainly grown on me, %player%. And I reckon I'd like to see where this goes. So, yes!
I spend most of my days working with iron, but somehow you've managed to get through this thick skull of mine. Hah! Yes, I'd be happy to be with you.
Well, I never thought I'd be having this conversation. But there's no point pretending otherwise. I like you too, %player%. Let's give it a proper chance!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.dating_den: That's a tough one... You're a good person, but I don't reckon I feel that way about you. I'd rather be straight with you.
I'm flattered, truly. But my heart isn't in it. Don't go thinking any less of yourself because of that.
You're a fine friend, %player%, but I don't think we're meant for anything more. Hope we can leave it at that.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.default_gi: For me? Hah, that's mighty kind of you. Much appreciated, friend!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.dislike.1: Can't say it's something I'd choose for myself. Rather have some %like% instead.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.divorce.1: So that's it, then? Hmph. I won't pretend I'm happy about it, but I'm not about to beg you to stay. I hope things work out for you, %player%.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.divorce.2: Guess even the strongest things can break eventually. Can't say I expected this, but I won't stand in your way. Take care of yourself.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.divorce.3: Hah... I always thought we could work through anything if we tried hard enough. Seems I was wrong about that. I'll remember the good times, at least.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.divorce_er: Divorce? What are you talking about? We aren't even married! Try getting the basics right before breaking things apart.
Now that's a strange request. Can't break a bond that was never forged in the first place, can you?
Already looking to get rid of me? Hah! Well, you'll have to marry me first, and I don't recall that happening.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.first.1:
Hah! Careful where you stand, stranger! 
Don't want you getting in the way of my work. 
Name's %npc%, and I'm the blacksmith around these parts. If you've got tools that need fixing or metal that needs shaping, you've come to the right place.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.first.2:
Well, look at that. A visitor! 
I'm %npc%, local blacksmith. Been working the forge for more years than I care to count. There's nothing quite like making something useful with your own two hands.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.first.3:
Greetings! I'm %npc%. If it's made of metal, chances are I can work with it. 
Been at this craft for most of my life, and I don't intend to stop anytime soon. A good forge is a man's best companion!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.first.4:
Another traveler, eh? Welcome! I'm %npc%, the village blacksmith. 
Don't mind the noise, the sparks, or the occasional bit of smoke. Just the sound of honest work being done!
Can't today. Got a pile of orders waiting, and those aren't going to finish themselves.
Tempting, but I've got work to do. A blacksmith's responsibilities don't take days off.
Not this time, friend. I've got a particularly stubborn piece of iron waiting for me, and I intend to win that argument.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.follow_sto: Alright, back to the forge for me. There's always something that needs hammering into shape.
That was a good bit of exercise! Give me a hot forge over a comfortable chair any day.
Well, that was worth the trip. You know where to find me if you need a strong arm again.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.follow_tal: Keep your eyes open, %player%. I'd rather not have to drag you back to the village in pieces.
Hah! This is a nice change of pace. Been spending too much time standing in front of that forge lately.
Don't worry about me. I've hauled heavier things than this before breakfast. Just keep moving!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.follow_yes: An adventure, eh? Sounds like a fine way to stretch my legs. Let me grab my hammer, just in case.
Sure, why not? Been staring at that forge long enough. A little excitement won't hurt.
Count me in! Just don't expect me to complain about a little hard work. That's what keeps a person strong!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.greeting.1:
Well, if it isn't %player%! How've you been holding up? 
Still swinging that sword of yours around?
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.greeting.2:
Hah! Good to see you again! 
Was just finishing up some work. Nothing beats a productive day at the forge.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.greeting.3:
Morning, %player%! Or afternoon... doesn't matter much to me. 
The forge doesn't care what time it is, and neither do I.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.greeting.4:
Ah, there you are! 
Come to have a chat, or have you finally managed to break something I made?
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.hate.1:
What in blazes is this supposed to be? 
I've no use for something like this. Hmph, some gifts are better left unwrapped.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.like.1:
Now that's a fine gift! Hah! 

You've got a good eye, %player%. Much obliged!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.marriage_a: Marriage, eh? Never thought I'd be settling down like this. But if there's one thing I've learned from working metal, it's that the best things are worth committing yourself to. Yes, I'll marry you!
You really want to spend your life with a stubborn old blacksmith like me? Hah! Well, I can't say I'd want it any other way. Yes, %player%, let's do it!
I've spent my life making things meant to last. I reckon it's time I built something lasting of my own. A life with you sounds like a fine place to start. I accept!
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.marriage_d: Now hold on, that's a mighty big question. I care about you, but I don't want to rush into something like this. Give me a little more time.
Hah... marriage isn't something you hammer together in an afternoon. I need to be sure before I make a promise like that. Hope you understand.
I won't lie to you, %player%. I'm not ready for that kind of commitment just yet. Doesn't mean I don't care, though.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.procreatio: Easy there, friend. Even the strongest need a little time to recover. No need to rush things.
Not just yet. Good work takes time, and that goes for more than just smithing. Let's be patient.
I've spent enough years working myself to the bone to know when it's time to take a break. How about we enjoy a quiet evening instead?
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.talk.1: A proper weapon isn't just a piece of metal with a sharp edge. It's something you put your heart into. Every strike of the hammer matters, every little detail counts.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.talk.2: People keep telling me I ought to slow down. Hah! What would I do with all that spare time? Sit around and stare at the walls? I'd rather be buried under a pile of iron than give up my work.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.talk.3: I've seen plenty of folk try their hand at smithing. Most give up after the first few blisters. It's not a craft for the impatient, I'll tell you that much. Takes strength, practice, and a stubborn head.
npc.runecraftory.blacksmith.1.talk.4: You know what bothers me? People throwing away perfectly good equipment just because it's a little worn. A bit of work and some patience can bring almost anything back to life. Nothing should go to waste if it can still serve a purpose.
